comments.body: Moving this to rework because it is going to depend on the plan for V1
@elarlang what do you think about this? I could move it to V14 although it does not quite fit...

We have also other architecture decisions towards how to organize or use/place components safely, although those are dependency related:
* 14.2.6
* 14.2.7
* 14.2.8

One option is to create one chapter to V10 (need to rename and redescrribe the V10 for that)

So 1.14.5 is not just about 3rd party components but general dangerous stuff and general segmentation.

It would seem to be a true architecture requirement but I am not sure whether it is specific enough to really be enforceable. It is also a little abstracted from the code which is why I prefer V14 to V10.

Agreed in a discussion with Elar just now that this makes sense for V10 architecture, I will open a PR.
